column5: A dozen countries, including Britain and Spain, are now toying with the idea; so are legislators in many American states.
column6:
① 谁：A dozen countries
   做了什么：are now toying with the idea
② 正常语序：A dozen countries, including Britain and Spain, are now toying with the idea; legislators in many American states are toying with the idea.
③ 简单英文：Several countries are considering the idea, and so are many American legislators.
   难词：toying with=不太认真地考虑；legislators=立法委员；dozen=十几个
column8:
① 谁：A dozen countries
   做了什么：are now toying with the idea
② 正常语序：A dozen countries, including Britain and Spain, are now toying with the idea; legislators in many American states are also toying with the idea.
③ 简单英文：About twelve countries, including Britain and Spain, are now thinking about the idea, but not very seriously. People who make laws in many American states are doing the same.
   难词：toying with=不太认真地考虑；legislators=立法委员；dozen=十几个，一打
column10:
原结论栏内容：对
dozen 的基本义是十二个；several 过于笼统。many 修饰 American states，不能直接改成 many American legislators。简单英文保留 toy with 尚未认真承诺的意味。

column5: A dozen countries, including Britain and Spain, are now toying with the idea; so are legislators in many American states.
column6:
美国的立法者们对于禁止青少年使用社交媒体的态度是什么？
   A. 他们正在认真考虑
✔ B. 他们也在考虑这个想法
   C. 他们坚决反对
column8:
What is the attitude of lawmakers in many American states toward banning young people from social media?
   A. They are thinking about it very seriously.
✔ B. They are also thinking about it.
   C. They are firmly against it.

column5: Parents have been shaken by tragedies in which social media have played a role, of children being tricked into sharing explicit pictures of themselves, or taking their own lives after algorithms shovelled them content about self-harm.
column6:
这句话主要在说什么？
   A. 社交媒体让家长感到安心
   B. 算法总是阻止有害内容
✔ C. 家长被一些悲剧事件所震撼，这些悲剧中社交媒体参与了，比如儿童被诱骗发送露骨照片或自杀
column7: 正确项明显比其他选项长（42 字 vs 11 字），可能被猜出来
column8:
What is this sentence mainly about?
   A. Social media have made parents stop worrying about their children's safety.
   B. Social media algorithms have kept children away from self-harm content.
✔ C. Terrible events involving children and social media have deeply upset parents.
column10:
原结论栏内容：确实很容易被猜出来
正确答案方向正确，但明显更长且干扰项容易排除。缩短正确项，保持三个选项结构和长度接近。

column5: Along with those shocking cases comes a second, more general worry: that social media might be damaging children as a group, making them reserved, lonely and anxious.
column6:
① 谁：a second, more general worry
   做了什么：comes
② 正常语序：A second, more general worry comes along with those shocking cases: that social media might be damaging children as a group, making them reserved, lonely and anxious.
③ 简单英文：Besides those shocking cases, there is also a broader worry that social media could be harming all children, making them shy, lonely, and anxious.
   难词：reserved=内向的，不爱说话的；along with=连同，除了……之外；general=普遍的；damaging=有害的
column7: 「做了什么」只有一个词 comes，可能太单薄
column8:
① 谁：a second, more general worry
   做了什么：comes
② 正常语序：A second, more general worry comes along with those shocking cases: that social media might be damaging children as a group, making them reserved, lonely and anxious.
③ 简单英文：Besides those terrible events, people also worry that social media might harm children as a group and make them lonely, worried and less willing to talk.
   难词：reserved=内向的，不爱说话的；along with=连同，除了……之外；general=普遍的；damaging=损害，伤害
column10:
原结论栏内容：确实，这句句子的谓语确实只有comes一个词
comes 确实是主句的谓语动词，不因只有一个词就算错；第一级补足 along with 短语便于理解。as a group 指群体层面，不等于每一个孩子。

column5: Along with those shocking cases comes a second, more general worry: that social media might be damaging children as a group, making them reserved, lonely and anxious.
column6:
除了那些令人震惊的案例，还有什么担忧？
   A. 担忧主要在于社交媒体让孩子沉迷游戏
   B. 没有其他担忧了
✔ C. 社交媒体使整个儿童群体变得害羞、孤独和焦虑
column8:
Apart from those shocking cases, what other worry is mentioned?
   A. Social media might cause a few children to be tricked and badly hurt.
   B. Social media might make children play too many games and ignore their studies.
✔ C. Social media might make children as a whole feel shy, alone and nervous.
column10:
原结论栏内容：对
原文是 worry 和 might，属于担忧及可能性，不能写成已确定发生的事实。reserved 在这里是内向、寡言。

column5: But the claim that social media cause great damage to the mental health of young people as a whole has only limited evidence.
column6:
① 谁：the claim that social media cause great damage to the mental health of young people as a whole
   做了什么：has only limited evidence
② 正常语序：There is only limited evidence for the claim that social media cause great damage to the mental health of young people as a whole.
③ 简单英文：The idea that social media strongly hurt all young people's mental health has only a little support.
   难词：claim=说法；主张；great damage=巨大伤害；mental health=心理健康；as a whole=整体上
column8:
① 谁：the claim that social media cause great damage to the mental health of young people as a whole
   做了什么：has only limited evidence
② 正常语序：There is only limited evidence for the claim that social media cause great damage to the mental health of young people as a whole.
③ 简单英文：There is only limited evidence that social media seriously harm the mental health of young people as a group.
   难词：claim=说法；主张；great damage=巨大伤害；mental health=心理健康；as a whole=整体上
column10:
原结论栏内容：对
as a whole 是整体层面，不是 all young people（每一个年轻人）；明确 support 是证据支持。

column5: But the claim that social media cause great damage to the mental health of young people as a whole has only limited evidence.
column6:
作者对“社交媒体伤害年轻人心理健康”这一说法怎么看？
   A. 完全错误
   B. 证据充分
✔ C. 证据有限
column8:
What does the author think of the idea that social media seriously hurt the mental health of young people in general?
   A. It has been shown to be totally wrong.
   B. It is supported by plenty of proof.
✔ C. It is not supported by much proof.
column10:
原结论栏内容：对
原句限定 great damage 和 as a whole。原题遗漏限定，易与前句“至少部分孩子受害”的证据混淆。答案 C 不变。

column5: And even if you wanted to ban social media as a precaution pending conclusive findings, such measures threaten to be counterproductive.
column6:
① 谁：such measures
   做了什么：threaten to be counterproductive
② 正常语序：Even if you wanted to ban social media as a precaution pending conclusive findings, such measures threaten to be counterproductive.
③ 简单英文：Taking these steps could be harmful, even before we have clear proof of harm.
   难词：as a precaution=作为预防措施；pending=在……之前；等到；conclusive findings=确凿的结论；counterproductive=适得其反的
column8:
① 谁：such measures
   做了什么：threaten to be counterproductive
② 正常语序：Even if you wanted to ban social media as a precaution pending conclusive findings, such measures threaten to be counterproductive.
③ 简单英文：Even if we banned social media to protect children while waiting for clear findings, the bans could have the opposite effect.
   难词：as a precaution=作为预防措施；pending=在等待……期间；在……得出之前；conclusive findings=确凿的结论；counterproductive=适得其反的
column10: 恢复 even if 的让步关系、预防目的和等待结论期间的时间含义。counterproductive 是与预期效果相反，不仅是 harmful。pending 的介词义参见 https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/pending_1 。

column5: And even if you wanted to ban social media as a precaution pending conclusive findings, such measures threaten to be counterproductive.
column6:
作者认为，在结论明确前就禁止社交媒体，这种做法可能怎样？
✔ A. 会带来适得其反的结果
   B. 完全没有必要
   C. 能有效保护孩子
column8:
What does the author think about banning social media just in case?
✔ A. It could end up making the problem worse.
   B. It could keep children completely away from harm.
   C. It would be the safest way to protect children.

column5: Kids barred from mainstream sites could flock to obscure ones, and fall victim to predators there.
column6:
被禁止访问主流网站的孩子可能会怎样？
   A. 更加努力学习
✔ B. 转而涌向不知名网站，可能遇到坏人
   C. 乖乖遵守规定
column7: 正确项明显比其他选项长（16 字 vs 6 字），可能被猜出来
column8:
What might happen to children who are banned from mainstream sites?
   A. They go back to mainstream sites and get more protection.
✔ B. They move to little-known sites and get hurt by bad people.
   C. They give up all websites and talk to people offline instead.
column10: 原句不只是“遇到坏人”，而是可能成为其受害者。三个选项长度和句式接近，答案 B 不变。

column5: Moreover, the proponents of bans ignore how they would deprive children of the benefits of social media.
column6:
① 谁：the proponents of bans
   做了什么：ignore
② 正常语序：Moreover, the proponents of bans ignore how they would deprive children of the benefits of social media.
③ 简单英文：People who support bans do not think about one thing: bans would take away the good things social media gives children.
   难词：proponents=支持者；bans=禁令；deprive=剥夺；benefits=好处
column7: 「做了什么」只有一个词 ignore，可能太单薄
column8:
① 谁：the proponents of bans
   做了什么：ignore how they would deprive children of the benefits of social media
② 正常语序：Moreover, the proponents of bans ignore how they would deprive children of the benefits of social media.
③ 简单英文：People who support bans do not think about one thing: bans would take away the good things social media give children.
   难词：they=指禁令（bans）；proponents=支持者；bans=禁令；deprive=剥夺；benefits=好处
column10: 第一级补足 ignore 的宾语从句并解释 they 指禁令。原文将 social media 作为复数使用，简单英文与其一致。

column5: They are a blessing to children who feel isolated: perhaps because of their location, their sexuality, or because their brains work differently from those of others.
column6:
① 谁：They
   做了什么：are
② 正常语序：They are a blessing to children who feel isolated: perhaps because of their location, their sexuality, or because their brains work differently from those of others.
③ 简单英文：Social media is a good thing for children who feel alone. They may feel alone because of where they live, their sexuality, or because their brains work in a different way.
   难词：blessing=好事，幸事；isolated=孤独的；sexuality=性取向；differently=以不同的方式
column7: 「谁」只写了代词 They，没说指的是什么；「做了什么」只有一个词 are，可能太单薄
column8:
① 谁：They
   做了什么：are a blessing to children who feel isolated
② 正常语序：They are a blessing to children who feel isolated: perhaps because of their location, their sexuality, or because their brains work differently from those of others.
③ 简单英文：Social media are helpful to children who feel alone. These children may feel alone because of where they live, their sexuality, or because their brains work in a different way.
   难词：They=指社交媒体（social media）；blessing=好事，幸事；isolated=孤独的；sexuality=性取向；differently=以不同的方式
column10: 结合 S23–S24，They 指社交媒体；are 是系动词，应连同表语和受益对象展示。social media 的数与原文一致。

column5: It used to be easy for youngsters to pick up their parents’ printed newspapers.
column6:
① 谁：It
   做了什么：used to be easy for youngsters to pick up their parents’ printed newspapers
② 正常语序：It used to be easy for youngsters to pick up their parents’ printed newspapers.
③ 简单英文：In the past, it was easy for young people to read their parents’ paper newspapers.
   难词：youngsters=年轻人；printed newspapers=纸质报纸
column7: 「谁」只写了代词 It，没说指的是什么
column8:
① 谁：It
   做了什么：used to be easy for youngsters to pick up their parents’ printed newspapers
② 正常语序：It used to be easy for youngsters to pick up their parents’ printed newspapers.
③ 简单英文：In the past, it was easy for young people to read their parents’ paper newspapers.
   难词：It=指后面“年轻人拿起父母的纸质报纸来看”这件事；youngsters=年轻人；printed newspapers=纸质报纸
column10: It 是形式主语，没有需要找出的具体指代对象；真正主语是 to pick up their parents’ printed newspapers。自动提示不能机械理解为代词指代错误。

column5: They sat through news bulletins aired before or after their favourite shows.
column6:
① 谁：They
   做了什么：sat through news bulletins aired before or after their favourite shows
② 正常语序：They sat through news bulletins aired before or after their favourite shows.
③ 简单英文：In the past, young people watched the news that was shown before or after their favourite TV shows.
   难词：sat through=耐着性子看完；news bulletins=新闻简报；aired=播出；favourite shows=最喜欢的节目
column7: 「谁」只写了代词 They，没说指的是什么
column8:
① 谁：They
   做了什么：sat through news bulletins aired before or after their favourite shows
② 正常语序：They sat through news bulletins aired before or after their favourite shows.
③ 简单英文：In the past, young people watched the news that was shown before or after their favourite TV shows.
   难词：They=指上一句的 youngsters（年轻人）；sat through=耐着性子看完；news bulletins=新闻简报；aired=播出；favourite shows=最喜欢的节目
column10: 结合 S27 可确认 They 指年轻人，补充指代便于学生读懂。

column5: They sat through news bulletins aired before or after their favourite shows.
column6:
以前的年轻人是怎么接触到新闻的？
   A. 他们只能去电影院看新闻
✔ B. 他们会在喜欢看的节目播出前后看到新闻
   C. 他们从来不看新闻
column7: 正确项明显比其他选项长（18 字 vs 11 字），可能被猜出来
column8:
How did young people in the past come across the news?
   A. They watched the news only at the cinema.
✔ B. They watched the news between TV shows they loved.
   C. They never watched the news on TV at all.
column10: 答案 B 正确；压缩正确项，使其与干扰项长度接近，保留 before or after 的含义。

column5: 主题句 S07：The proposals arise from an understandable desire to keep youngsters safe and healthy.
column6:
这一段主要讲了什么？
   A. 限制社交媒体的提议毫无道理
   B. 社交媒体只对成年人产生负面影响
✔ C. 提议源于保护孩子的愿望，因为家长被社交媒体涉及的悲剧震惊，并担心社交媒体可能伤害所有孩子
要点（英文）：Proposals to limit social media come from a desire to keep children safe, as parents are shocked by tragedies involving social media and worry that social media may harm all children.
column7: 正确项明显比其他选项长（44 字 vs 15 字），可能被猜出来
column8:
What is this paragraph mainly about?
   A. Parents want to limit social media so that children can study more.
   B. Parents believe social media are safe and are against any limits.
✔ C. Parents want to protect children from both terrible events and wider harm.
要点（英文）：The bans come from a wish to keep children safe and healthy: parents are shocked by terrible cases linked to social media, and they also worry that social media might harm children as a group.
column10: 缩短正确项，避免长度泄露；保留保护动机、悲剧和更广泛担忧。as a group 不等于 all children。

column5: S04：A dozen countries, including Britain and Spain, are now toying with the idea; so are legislators in many American states.

英文（老师）：think about it vaguely, without serious commitment

column7: 正确项明显比其他选项长（7 字 vs 3 字），可能被猜出来
column8:

英文（老师）：think about it vaguely, without serious commitment
先猜后看：What does “toying with” most likely mean here?

column10: 含义、教师释义及答案 A 均正确。7字对3字的长度提示不足以判错；短词义题允许用常见义“玩玩具”作为熟词陷阱。

column5: Parents have been shaken by tragedies in which social media have played a role, of children being tricked into sharing explicit pictures of themselves, or taking their own lives after algorithms shovelled them content about self-harm.
column6:
① 谁：Parents
   做了什么：have been shaken by tragedies
② 正常语序：Parents have been shaken by tragedies in which social media have played a role, of children being tricked into sharing explicit pictures of themselves, or taking their own lives after algorithms shovelled them content about self-harm.
③ 简单英文：Parents are deeply shocked by terrible cases where social media was involved, such as children being tricked into sending naked photos or dying by suicide after seeing harmful content from algorithms.
   难词：explicit=露骨的；algorithm=算法；shovelled=大量推送；being tricked into=被诱骗去做
column8:

column8:
① 谁：Australia
   做了什么：has not banned young teenagers from messaging apps such as WhatsApp, or from multiplayer online games
② 正常语序：Australia has not banned young teenagers from messaging apps such as WhatsApp, or from multiplayer online games, because that would have seemed too draconian; scourges such as cyberbullying will doubtless continue on these.
③ 简单英文：Australia has not banned young teenagers from using messaging apps like WhatsApp or playing multiplayer online games, because doing so would have seemed too harsh. Problems like cyberbullying will still happen on these apps and in these games.
   难词：draconian=严厉的；scourges=祸害；doubtless=毫无疑问；cyberbullying=网络霸凌
column10: draconian 是措施过于严苛，cruel 容易偏向残忍；these 同时指通讯应用和多人在线游戏。保留 has not banned 的时态及 multiplayer 限定。

column8:

column5: Children who evade the blocks may be less likely to tell adults if they find something horrid, for fear of being told off.

   A. Because they are too busy playing online games.
✔ B. Because they are worried about being scolded.
   C. Because they believe adults are unable to help.

column5: Moreover, the proponents of bans ignore how they would deprive children of the benefits of social media.

   A. Bans would make children want to use social media even more.
✔ B. Bans would take away the good things social media give children.

column5: Like it or not, social sites are now one of the main ways children obtain information (as well as misinformation) about current affairs.

column8:
① 谁：social sites
   做了什么：are now one of the main ways children obtain information (as well as misinformation) about current affairs

column5: Like it or not, social sites are now one of the main ways children obtain information (as well as misinformation) about current affairs.
column6:
关于时事信息，作者说现在的情况是怎样的？
   A. 孩子完全无法获取任何信息
   B. 孩子只从老师和家长那里获取信息
✔ C. 孩子主要通过社交平台获取信息，其中也可能有假消息
column8:
What does the author say about how children get news today?
   A. They have no way at all of getting any kind of news.
   B. They get their news only from their teachers and parents.
✔ C. They get lots of news from social media, but some is false.
column10: 恢复 one of 和 current affairs 的限定，避免夸大社交平台所占份额；调整题干和选项，使长度接近。答案 C 不变。

column5: 主题句 S06：The problem is, bans will do more harm than good.
column6:

✔ A. 反对
   B. 不确定
   C. 支持
要点（英文）：Banning social media for teenagers does more harm than good.
column8:
What is the author's attitude toward banning social media for young people?
✔ A. Opposed.
   B. Unsure.
   C. Supportive.
要点（英文）：Banning social media for teenagers does more harm than good.

column5: 主题句 S12：Blanket bans appear to offer an easy answer — and politicians are only too happy to seize on a measure that, for once, pleases voters from all parties.
column6:
这段文字主要谈论了什么？
✔ A. 政客们乐于推行全面禁令，因为这能同时满足父母和选民
   B. 父母支持全面禁令以避免孩子受伤害
   C. 孩子们希望被禁止使用社交媒体
要点（英文）：Parents worry about children wasting time on social media, and politicians eagerly use blanket bans to gain voter support.
column8:
What is this paragraph mainly about?
✔ A. Parents worry their children will be left out, so bans look like a simple solution that politicians welcome.
   B. Parents trust their children to manage their own time online, so they think no ban is needed at all.
   C. Political parties keep arguing about bans, so most politicians are unwilling to say what they really think.
要点（英文）：Parents worry about time wasted online but do not want their children to be left out, so blanket bans look like an easy answer that politicians are happy to support.
column10: 结合第3段 S10–S12，补入家长担心孩子成为班里唯一不上应用者的两难。正确项不能只概括政客动机；避免与只说家长支持禁令的选项重叠。

column5: 主题句 S14：The question of whether social media are causing mass harm is far from settled.
column6:
本段主要在讨论什么？
   A. 社交媒体对年轻人没有伤害，应该取消限制
✔ B. 社交媒体是否造成大规模伤害尚无定论，仓促禁止可能适得其反
   C. 已有充分证据证明社交媒体对所有孩子都有害
要点（英文）：There is no clear proof yet that social media hurt most young people, and banning them may bring bad results.
column8:
What is this paragraph mainly about?
   A. Social media do not harm young people at all, so all limits on them should be removed.
✔ B. It is unclear whether social media cause widespread harm, and bans could make things worse.
   C. There is already plenty of proof that social media are harmful to every single child.
要点（英文）：Social media may hurt some children, but we still do not know if they seriously harm young people as a group, and bans could make things worse.
column10: most young people 擅自引入数量比例；原段重点是整体心理健康严重损害的证据有限，且承认至少部分孩子可能受害。恢复 counterproductive 的含义。

column5: 主题句 S18：One problem is that enforcing bans is hard; teenagers in Australia are finding ingenious ways to get round them, by scrunching up their faces to look older.
column6:
这一段主要在讨论什么？
✔ A. 澳大利亚实施社交媒体禁令遇到的困难
   B. 青少年如何用巧妙的方式绕开禁令
   C. 社交媒体对青少年的各种危害
要点（英文）：There are many difficulties in carrying out social media bans, and bans may push children to riskier places.
column8:
What is this paragraph mainly about?
✔ A. Bans are difficult to carry out and may make children less safe.
   B. Teenagers in Australia have found clever ways to get around the bans.
   C. Social media cause many different kinds of harm to young teenagers.
要点（英文）：There are many difficulties in carrying out social media bans, and bans may push children to riskier places.
column10: 结合完整第5段 S18–S22，A 概括执行难度及禁令风险，B 只覆盖其中一个例子。答案 A 与英文要点可保留。

column5: 主题句 S23：Moreover, the proponents of bans ignore how they would deprive children of the benefits of social media.
column6:
这一段主要想说什么？

   B. 社交媒体禁令利大于弊，应该尽快实施
   C. 孩子不应该接触新闻，因为容易看到假消息
要点（英文）：Social media can also bring benefits to children, such as broadening their minds and helping them get information.
column8:
What is this paragraph mainly about?
✔ A. Social media also help children by opening their eyes and bringing them news.
   B. Social media bans do more good than harm and should start soon.
   C. Children should stay away from the news because much of it is false.
要点（英文）：Social media can also bring benefits to children, such as broadening their minds and helping them get information.
column10: 结合完整第6段 S23–S29，答案 A 及英文要点正确；其核心是社交媒体带来的益处。
